Book Title: There Was an Old Lady Who Swallowed a Turkey!
Author: Lucille Colandro, Jared Lee
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Holidays & Celebrations > Thanksgiving
Summary: Celebrate Thanksgiving with a twist on the classic song from the bestselling  There Was an Old Lady  series for kids! You’ll never guess what she’ll swallow next! There was an old lady who swallowed a turkey. I don't know why she swallowed the turkey, But she's always been quirky! It's Thanksgiving and this time the Old Lady is swallowing a turkey, a ball, a hat, a balloon, a boat, some wheels, and a horn of plenty! With hilarious illustrations and a lively rhyme, this is sure to be a seasonal favorite! Also in the There Was an Old Lady series: There Was an Old Lady Who Swallowed Some Leaves! There Was an Old Lady Who Swallowed a Bat! There Was an Old Lady Who Swallowed a Clover! and more!
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this book great for kids, particularly during Thanksgiving, and appreciate it as a fun addition to the Old Lady book series. The story receives positive feedback for its humor and readability, with one customer noting it's a must-read around Thanksgiving as a read-aloud. The illustrations are well-received, and one customer mentions it's great for introducing comprehension. The rhyme quality receives mixed reviews, with some praising the rhymes while others find them poor.

Little Ghost and his mom have been happily haunting their creaky old house for years, just the two of them. When a new girl moves in next door, Little Ghost wants to introduce himself. But making friends can be scary…until he comes up with the perfect plan: he’s going to invite her over for a Halloween party! But what costume will make her want to be friends with him?

Book Title: Gustavo, the Shy Ghost: (A Halloween Picture Book Celebrating Friendship, Courage, and Cultural Traditions - For Toddlers, Preschoolers, and 1-2 Graders) (The World of Gustavo)
Author: Flavia Z. Drago
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Growing Up & Facts of Life > Friendship, Social Skills & School Life > Friendship
Summary: A #1  New York Times  bestseller! This winning debut picture book from Mexican artist Flavia Z. Drago about finding the courage to make friends is perfect for the spooky season — or anytime. Gustavo is good at doing all sorts of ghostly things: walking through walls, making objects fly, and glowing in the dark. And he loves almost nothing more than playing beautiful music on his violin. But Gustavo is shy, and some things are harder for him to do, like getting in a line to buy eye scream or making friends with other monsters. Whenever he tries getting close to them, he realizes they just can’t see him. Now that the Day of the Dead is fast approaching, what can he do to make them notice him and to share with them something he loves? With fancifully detailed artwork and visual humor, debut picture-book creator Flavia Z. Drago’s vivid illustrations tell a sweet and gently offbeat story of loneliness, bravery, and friendship that is sure to be a treat for little ghouls and goblins everywhere.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers love the book's cute illustrations and sweet storyline about shyness, making it a favorite for Halloween and Dia de los Muertos. Moreover, the book effectively validates shy children and teaches meaningful messages about friendship, with one customer noting how it shows the true meaning of life. Additionally, customers appreciate its awesome colors, and one mentions how it brings the monster world to life without being scary.

Book Title: How to Catch a Witch: A Halloween Picture Book for Kids
Author: Alice Walstead, Megan Joyce
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Literature & Fiction > Poetry > Stories In Verse
Summary: A  New York Times  and  USA Today  bestseller from the hit How to Catch series! Do YOU have what it takes to snatch a Halloween witch? It's Halloween night and something doesn't seem quite right... When the How to Catch Kids head out to trick-or-treat, there are ghosts, goblins, and ghouls everywhere! Our heroes discover a witch on a broom has opened a magical portal that let out spooky creatures all over the neighborhood. Follow along in this frightfully fun story as they set zany traps for the witch to close the portal and save Halloween before all the candy is gone! How to Catch a Witch  is a treat sure to delight young readers and educators alike with STEAM concepts and classic hilarity and chaos. The perfect Halloween gift or basket stuffer that kids ages 3-7 will love! You've been waiting all year long to trick-or-treat with friends. But wait―a witch is on the loose! We'll catch her before night's end! Also in the How to Catch Series: How to Catch a Monster How to Catch a Unicorn How to Catch a Mermaid How to Catch a Dinosaur How to Catch an Elf and more!
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find the book fun to read, keeping kids engaged from start to finish, and particularly suitable for young children as a Halloween gift. The illustrations receive positive feedback for being really cute. However, the writing quality is criticized for being poorly executed, with words not flowing together well. Moreover, the story quality receives mixed reactions, with some finding it cute while others say the storyline makes no sense.
Editorial Reviews (Text): About the Author Alice Walstead is a children’s book author who loves to make kids smile with her stories.

Summary: New York Times  bestselling creators James and Kimberly Dean show us all the wonderful things about autumn. A great book to share with the family at Thanksgiving or anytime—complete with 12 cards, a poster, and stickers! Pete the Cat isn't sure about the changing of the seasons from summer to autumn. But when he discovers corn mazes, hay rides, and apple picking, Pete realizes there's so much to enjoy and be thankful for about autumn. Pete the Cat: Falling for Autumn  includes 12 Thanksgiving cards, a fold-out poster, and fun stickers! Share this book with your family—a fun way to connect family members near and far while entertaining kids.
